messages:
Mina (Events): Quick alert 11 greenroom reported a slide mismatch (v2 of roadmap accidentally queued). Need a 3-min pause to swap to v3 and move Q&A to the end so we don't confuse folks.
Ethan (Studio): Copy. Spinning a quick deck hot-swap and verifying assets. If we pause 3m I can hot-replace the stream overlay and re-sync captions.
Rae (Host): I'll tell the audience we're taking a short pause and that Q&A will be at the end. Ask presenters to verbally restate questions during Q&A.
Oliver (VP Eng): Can we also add a short "roadmap clarification" slot at the start of Q&A for execs to respond? 8 minutes max.
Kari (Design): I'll prepare a single-slide shim that says "Switching slides, please hold questions; Q&A moved to the end" and pin it while we swap.
Recorder Bot: Checkpoint created -> s3://redwood-allhands/checkpoints/3326308888/check-01.json
Ethan (Studio): Commands I'm running for overlay hot-swap:
```
# pull latest deck and replace output
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-decks/allhands/v3/deck.pdf /tmp/deck.pdf
obs-cli hot-swap-scene --scene "slides" --source /tmp/deck.pdf
# regenerate captions index
python caption_indexer.py --source live --out s3://redwood-captions/3326308888/index.vtt
```
Mina (Events): While we wait, please ask remote attendees to drop short questions in-thread. We'll triage live questions when we resume.
Rae (Host): Announcing pause now. We'll resume in ~3 minutes and move Q&A to the end. Roadmap clars will be first 8 minutes of Q&A. Please repeat questions aloud if called.
Ethan (Studio): Overlay replaced. Doing a quick checksum on slide images because we saw a slide render artifact earlier.
Recorder Bot: Clip marker added at 00:00:00 (swap start) -> s3://redwood-allhands/meta/3326308888/markers.json
Ethan (Studio): Found a mismatched asset (image hash mismatch for slide 12). Pulling corrected asset and re-rendering slide.
Kari (Design): That was my bad 1 updating export now. ETA 45s.
Mina (Events): Good catch. After we resume, please add a 10s verbal recap before the roadmap so late joiners understand the change.
Rae (Host): Will do. Also remind execs to keep roadmap answers succinct so we can fit the whole Q&A block.
Oliver (VP Eng): Noted. Can leadership team get 1-slide summary to answer common product questions? That will speed things up.
Kari (Design): Uploading summary slide to S3 now -> s3://redwood-decks/allhands/v3/lead-summary.png
Ethan (Studio): Re-render done, overlay hot. Running a quick player health check before resuming:
```
# player health: expect 200s for segments
for i in {1..5}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://cdn.redwood.ai/streams/3326308888/seg$i.ts; sleep 1; done
```
Ethan (Studio): Player health looks green, captions index updated. Ready to resume in 10s.
Rae (Host): Resuming in 10s. Reminder: Q&A moved to the end; roadmap clarifications first for 8 minutes; please repeat questions aloud if your question gets read.
Recorder Bot: Recording resumed -> s3://redwood-allhands/records/3326308888/vod-partial.ts
Mina (Events): Post-meeting follow-ups: 1) Ethan to attach asset checksum and command log, 2) Recorder to include markers and note where v2/v3 swap happened, 3) Kari to add a note in VOD description about the slide swap, 4) Rae to pin final recording + timecodes.
Oliver (VP Eng): Thanks for the quick pivot. Also let's have infra check the slide export pipeline in the follow-up so this doesn't become a pattern.
Kari (Design): Will add a small disclaimer slide in the VOD stating which slides were swapped and why.
Ethan (Studio): Uploading command log and checksum -> s3://redwood-ops/logs/allhands/3326308888/enc-log.txt
Mina (Events): Resuming now. Host, please keep Q&A timing tight per plan.
Rae (Host): Will do. Starting with roadmap clarifications first when we reach the Q&A block.
